## Constants

### brandCommand

```ts
const brandCommand: import("./execute.js").Command<{
    readonly lead: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly required: true;
        readonly description: "leading colour, hex. Your primary; it leads the charge upper-left";
    };
    readonly follow: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly required: true;
        readonly description: "following colour, hex. Your secondary; it follows lower-right";
    };
    readonly name: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly description: "brand name, used as the accessible label and card title";
    };
    readonly ground: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly default: "#0a0a0a";
        readonly description: "the field’s dark midpoint, which is what keeps the charge legible";
    };
    readonly charge: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly description: "path to an SVG whose contents replace the bars, drawn in a 0 0 100 100 box";
    };
    readonly bordure: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly description: "outline colour, hex. Omit for no outline";
    };
    readonly bordureWidth: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly default: "1.5";
        readonly description: "outline width";
    };
    readonly tagline: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly description: "one line under the name on the card and cover";
    };
    readonly out: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly description: "directory to write into. Omit to print the flag only";
    };
    readonly on: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly description: "page colour(s) the flag will fly on, comma separated. Checked for contrast";
    };
    readonly allowLowContrast: {
        readonly type: "boolean";
        readonly description: "emit anyway when a contrast check fails. Says so in the output";
    };
}, import("./manifest.js").CommandOutput, readonly []>;
```

### devCommand

`burgee dev <entry>` — watch the entry, reload it on change, serve it as MCP on stdio
and print every surface on each save (dev-loop). Loaded only when asked for, so the
CLI's own weight and the framework's stay what they were (W4).

```ts
const devCommand: import("./execute.js").Command<{
    readonly noWatch: {
        readonly type: "boolean";
        readonly description: "load once and serve; do not watch for changes";
    };
}, import("./manifest.js").CommandOutput, readonly [{
    readonly name: "entry";
    readonly description: "the module that exports the program, as program or as its default export";
    readonly required: true;
}]>;
```

### initCommand

`burgee init [dir]` — a first CLI in one command (first-cli R1–R5): the README quick start as
`cli.mjs` and the `package.json` that runs it, and nothing else. Loaded on this path only, like
`migrate` and `skill`, so neither `import 'burgee'` nor a user's bundle carries it.

```ts
const initCommand: import("./execute.js").Command<{
    readonly install: {
        readonly type: "boolean";
        readonly description: "run the install with the package manager this ran under";
    };
    readonly force: {
        readonly type: "boolean";
        readonly description: "overwrite cli.mjs and package.json when they are already there";
    };
}, import("./manifest.js").CommandOutput, readonly [{
    readonly name: "dir";
    readonly description: "the directory to write into. Defaults to the current directory";
    readonly required: false;
}]>;
```

### migrateCommand

`burgee migrate [dir]` — rewrite a commander or yargs project's imports to burgee's
drop-in front-ends and report what changed, with the numbers that say why it was safe.

```ts
const migrateCommand: import("./execute.js").Command<{
    readonly dryRun: {
        readonly type: "boolean";
        readonly description: "scan and report; write nothing";
    };
    readonly force: {
        readonly type: "boolean";
        readonly description: "migrate even though the git tree has uncommitted changes";
    };
    readonly only: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly multiple: true;
        readonly placeholder: "lib,…";
        readonly description: "rewrite only these incumbents, by package name, declared or not";
    };
    readonly skip: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly multiple: true;
        readonly placeholder: "lib,…";
        readonly description: "leave these incumbents alone, by package name";
    };
}, import("./manifest.js").CommandOutput, readonly [{
    readonly name: "dir";
    readonly description: "the project to migrate. Defaults to the current directory";
    readonly required: false;
}]>;
```

### pluginCheckCommand

`burgee check <plugin-file>` — the feedback loop PRINCIPLES 7 asks every extension surface
for, and the one burgee did not have. See `check.ts`: this one returns its report as data, so
`--json` is the form an agent that just wrote a plugin reads.

```ts
const pluginCheckCommand: import("./execute.js").Command<import("./execute.js").OptionSpecs, import("./manifest.js").CommandOutput, readonly [{
    readonly name: "file";
    readonly description: "the plugin module to check";
}]>;
```

### skillCommand

`burgee skill <entry> [--out <dir>] [--check]` — the program's Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`) and its
`AGENTS.md`, projected from its declaration and written beside its binary (agent-skill R3).
`--check` writes nothing and exits 1 when the files there differ from the projection, for an
author's own CI. Loaded on this path only, like `dev` and `migrate`.

```ts
const skillCommand: import("./execute.js").Command<{
    readonly out: {
        readonly type: "string";
        readonly placeholder: "dir";
        readonly description: "directory to write into. Defaults to the directory of the bin in the entry's package.json";
    };
    readonly check: {
        readonly type: "boolean";
        readonly description: "write nothing; exit 1 when the files there differ from the projection";
    };
}, import("./manifest.js").CommandOutput, readonly [{
    readonly name: "entry";
    readonly description: "the module that exports the program, as program or as its default export";
    readonly required: true;
}]>;
```
